check: When the diagram or explanation is redrawn or replaced, is there never a frame where it is empty or collapsed?
instruction: Build the next state before swapping it in; never clear a container and refill it across an await, timer or fetch.
threshold: 0 samples between beats with diagram container height 0 or 0 visible characters (50ms sampling misses shorter gaps)
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: chang-ungar1993 is pre-2005 and not age-exempt, so it counts only as support.

check: Do learner and playback controls stay at the same position across beats on the same page?
instruction: Reserve fixed space for controls and variable-length text; do not recreate controls inside redrawn HTML.
threshold: Control bbox center shift ≤1px between beats on the same page
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Do scale and rotate animations on diagram elements pivot around the element's own center or an intended anchor?
instruction: For CSS transforms on SVG elements set transform-box: fill-box and an explicit transform-origin.
threshold: bbox center displacement during a scale/rotate-only animation ≤2% of SVG width
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Does the scene keep all content and functions when the viewport narrows or text is enlarged?
instruction: Size the diagram from its container (viewBox plus container-relative width, recompute scales on resize); avoid fixed pixel layouts.
threshold: Text resizable to 200% without loss of content or function; at 320 CSS px width no two-dimensional scrolling except the diagram itself
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: wcag22#8 exempts content that needs two-dimensional layout for meaning, which applies to the diagram.

check: At the start and end of each animation, is there no frame showing the previous state during a delay, the final state before the start, or a jump after the end?
instruction: Use fill-mode both (or apply start values before inserting the element) and make the final style equal the last keyframe; do not redraw in end callbacks.
threshold: 0 position/opacity discontinuities (>8 units of SVG width 1000) within 100ms of an animation's start or end
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Do removed mechanism elements leave visibly (fade out or move to their destination) instead of vanishing in one frame?
instruction: Give every exit a short exit transition (fade or move); remove the node only after it finishes.
threshold: Exit transition ≥ the scene's shortest movement duration; 0 mechanism elements going from opacity 1 to 0 in one sample
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: Entrance side is covered by entrance-from-origin. heer2007 is age-exempt (perception/cognition).

check: After moving between beats or repeating an action, are there no leftover elements from earlier states or accumulating copies?
instruction: Render each state from data with keyed joins and explicit exit removal; never only append.
threshold: Element count and visible text after repeating the same action 3 times equal those after doing it once
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Do the intermediate frames of each transition remain valid graphics (no twisted paths, wrong-way rotation, or meaningless color passes)?
instruction: Match point counts before morphing paths, interpolate angles along the shortest arc, and interpolate color in a perceptual space.
threshold: None
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: heer2007#18: 'intermediate interpolation states remain valid data graphics'.

check: Do value labels attached to a mark change together with the mark rather than ahead of or behind it?
instruction: Tween the label with its mark, or update it when the mark's transition ends; use one duration for axes and data.
threshold: Label change time within the mark's transition window (start to end + 100ms)
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: heer2007#35 is about axis labels moving with scale changes; partial support.

check: Is animation speed independent of frame rate and does playback stay correct after the page is hidden and shown again?
instruction: Advance rAF animations by elapsed time, not a fixed per-frame increment; pause on visibilitychange and resume without catching up in one jump.
threshold: Duration differs ≤10% between a normal run and a 4x CPU-throttled run; 0 jumps after a hidden/visible switch
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Does every step or control action produce its first visible change almost immediately?
instruction: Start the visible response in the same event handler; do not defer the next beat with timers.
threshold: First visible change within 0.1s of the action
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: Conflicts with control-change-reruns (200–300ms rerun start); 0.1s is the first-change bound, the rerun bound can stay separate.

check: Under rapid repeated input, does each action advance exactly one step, continue from the current state, and never mix or stall beats?
instruction: Register listeners once; on interrupt, start the new transition from current DOM values; queue or ignore input during transitions; never wait only for transitionend.
threshold: Clicks n = step advances n; 0 position jumps on interrupt; 0 stalls >2s after an action; 0 opacity-0 samples during slider drag
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: After a control is activated and the scene updates, does keyboard focus stay on that control or its equivalent?
instruction: Update controls in place instead of recreating them; if recreated, restore focus to the equivalent control.
threshold: document.activeElement after activation is the same or equivalent control, never body
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Are visible controls never covered by animated elements or overlays that block pointer input?
instruction: Keep controls outside the animated layer or above it; set pointer-events: none on decorative overlays.
threshold: elementFromPoint at every visible control's center returns the control or its descendant in all samples
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Do deck pages other than the active one run no animations or timers?
instruction: Start a page's animations on page entry and stop its timers and rAF loops on page exit.
threshold: 0 running animations or bbox changes on non-active pages
glitches: 쪽 전환 중 두 쪽 공존
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: '숨은 쪽에서 미리 재생' is also covered by animation-starts-when-visible from the outcome side.

check: Does motion render at a steady frame rate without visible stutter?
instruction: Animate transform and opacity rather than layout properties; drive each property from one animation source; avoid heavy SVG filters on moving elements.
threshold: rAF interval p95 ≤33ms (≥30fps) during motion; 0 long tasks >50ms during motion
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: apple-hig-motion#18 states 30–60fps for games; chang-ungar1993 is support only. The user's 'rough' (line-by-line drawing) is an aesthetic defect, not this item.

check: Do changing numbers stay in place without horizontal wobble?
instruction: Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and a fixed text anchor for counting numbers.
threshold: Text bbox center drift ≤1px while only digits change
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Is the visible text free of raw markup such as TeX source or HTML escapes?
instruction: Render math before display or use plain Unicode; insert text with textContent.
threshold: 0 visible text matches of $…$, \frac-style commands, or </>/&
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py

check: Are beat and state changes exposed to assistive technology?
instruction: Put the beat explanation in an aria-live="polite" region or equivalent status element.
threshold: Explanation text changes occur inside a live region
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: 10 of 264 round-hsh scene files already use aria-live.

check: Does the reading position never move unless the learner scrolls?
instruction: Do not call focus() or scrollIntoView automatically; reserve space so content growth does not shift what is above the reading position.
threshold: 0 scrollTop changes of window or card scroll container without learner scroll input
evidence_method: main-agent grep of verified-quotes.md; not run through evidence.py
note: stable-frame (CLS) covers layout shift but not scroll position.
